Shop. Earn Rewards. Refer Friends. Save More.

Earn 1 Reward Credit for every Rp 10,000 spent on eligible purchases, collect credits across multiple orders and redeem 250 credits for Rp 250,000 OFF.

Plus, introduce a friend and you can both enjoy Rp 250,000 in savings.

Join Atlas Longevity Rewards for free and receive a Rp 50,000 welcome reward if eligible.

EXCLUSIVE MEMBER BENEFITS

Two Ways to Get Rewarded

Whether you’re shopping with Atlas Longevity or introducing friends, our free Rewards Programme gives you more ways to save.

01.   Shop & Earn Rewards

Every eligible purchase earns Reward Credits.

  • Earn 1 Reward Credit for every Rp 10,000 spent.
  • Collect credits across multiple qualifying orders.
  • Redeem 250 credits for Rp 250,000 OFF.
  • Minimum redemption order: Rp 2,500,000.
  • Maximum redemption: 250 credits per order.
  • Unused credits never expire.
Start Earning Credits

02.   Refer & Earn

Give Rp 250,000. Get Rp 250,000.

  • Share your unique referral link with a friend.
  • Your friend receives Rp 250,000 OFF their first qualifying order of Rp 3,000,000 or more.
  • Once their order is completed, you receive a Rp 250,000 discount reward.
  • Refer more eligible friends to earn additional rewards.
  • One coupon can be used per order.
Get My Referral Link

REWARDS CALCULATOR

See How Many Credits You Could Earn

Wondering how rewarding your next purchase could be? Enter your estimated eligible order value to see how many Reward Credits you could earn and how close you are to your next Rp 250,000 discount.

  1. Earn 1 Reward Credit for every Rp 10,000 spent.
  2. Collect 250 credits to unlock Rp 250,000 OFF.
  3. Redeem a maximum of 250 credits per order.
  4. Minimum eligible order for redemption: Rp 2,500,000.
  5. Any remaining credits stay in your account.
  6. Your credits never expire.
Start Earning Credits

Calculator results are estimates. Actual credits are calculated on eligible spending after discounts, excluding shipping and taxes. Credits earned on a purchase become available after that order is completed and cannot be redeemed against the same purchase.

SHOP. EARN. REDEEM.

Every Purchase Brings You Closer to a Reward

Earning Reward Credits with Atlas Longevity is simple.

Earn 1 Reward Credit for every Rp 10,000 spent on eligible purchases.

Your credits accumulate across multiple qualifying orders, so you don’t need to spend Rp 2,500,000 in a single purchase to earn your first 250 credits.

What If You Have More Than 250 Credits?

  • 250 credits: Redeem Rp 250,000 OFF one qualifying order.
  • 500 credits: Redeem 250 credits now and save 250 credits for another qualifying order.
  • 750 credits: Redeem 250 credits per qualifying order across three separate orders.

SHARE THE REWARDS

Give Rp 250,000. Get Rp 250,000.

Good things are worth sharing. Invite a friend to Atlas Longevity using your personal referral link and enjoy exclusive rewards together.

Your Friend Gets Rp 250,000 OFF

When a new customer uses your referral link, they'll receive Rp 250,000 OFF their first qualifying order of Rp 3,000,000 or more.

You Get Rp 250,000 OFF

Once your friend's qualifying purchase is completed, you'll receive a Rp 250,000 discount coupon towards an eligible future order.

Refer More Friends. Earn More Rewards.

There's no fixed limit to how many genuine new customers you can refer. Receive an additional Rp 250,000 discount reward for every successful qualifying referral. Each coupon can be redeemed on a separate eligible order.

GET MY REFERRAL LINK

Minimum referred customer’s first eligible order: Rp 3,000,000 before discounts. One coupon per order. Referral rewards do not expire.

OPEN MY REWARDS DASHBOARD

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Atlas Longevity Rewards?

Atlas Longevity Rewards is our free customer loyalty and referral programme. Eligible members can earn shopping credits, redeem discounts and receive rewards for introducing new customers.

Is it free to join?

Yes. Atlas Longevity Rewards is completely free.

Do I receive a welcome reward?

Eligible new members receive a one-time Rp 50,000 welcome reward.

How do I earn Reward Credits?

You earn 1 Reward Credit for every Rp 10,000 spent on eligible purchases.

How many credits will I earn if I spend Rp 1,500,000?

A qualifying Rp 1,500,000 purchase earns 150 Reward Credits.

How many credits do I need to redeem a reward?

You need 250 Reward Credits to unlock Rp 250,000 OFF.

What is the minimum order to redeem my credits?

Your order must contain at least Rp 2,500,000 of eligible products before applying the shopping reward discount.

Can I redeem more than 250 credits in one order?

No. You can redeem a maximum of 250 credits per qualifying order.

What happens if I have 500 credits?

You can redeem 250 credits on one qualifying order and keep the remaining 250 credits for another eligible order.

Do my Reward Credits expire?

No. Your earned Reward Credits never expire.

Can I combine rewards with other discount codes?

No. Only one coupon can be used per order. Shopping rewards, referral rewards, welcome coupons and other promotional codes cannot be combined.

How does the Refer a Friend Programme work?

Share your unique referral link with a new customer. They'll receive Rp 250,000 OFF their first qualifying order of at least Rp 3,000,000. Once their purchase is completed, you'll receive a Rp 250,000 discount reward.

Can I refer multiple friends?

Yes. You can receive additional rewards for each genuine, successful qualifying referral.

Do referral rewards expire?

No. Issued referral rewards do not expire.

When will my shopping credits be added?

Credits are added when your qualifying order reaches Completed status.

Can I use credits earned on my current order immediately?

No. Credits are awarded after the order is completed and can be redeemed on a future qualifying purchase.

Can I exchange my rewards for cash?

No. Rewards cannot be withdrawn, transferred or exchanged for cash.

Where can I view my rewards?

Sign in to your Atlas Longevity account and open your Rewards Dashboard.

Do all products qualify?

Not necessarily. Rewards are available only on eligible products and transactions.
